name: mirage
text:
v1.0.109 is out: https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.109
What changed on the tablet side: (1) with the GitHub engine driving, the app no longer logs, grades or looks up closes for the scan study itself (the engine already does); (2) on a low-RAM device the Feed's clock and its 15 s price re-reads run 2.5x slower, and the engine/orders/bids/usage reads also 2.5x slower on screen. Still open in LG3: I can't see the tablet's memory from here. Please open Settings > Diagnostics and share the file right after it lags (it has per-feature heap and frame timings), and I'll cut whatever it names next.
